The full count, top to bottom, is right below. Every line of Cowboys's prize table below is today's tally, not last month's.

2755.body: A $100,000 winner came off the board two weeks ago. Good for whoever's holding it — and worth knowing before you buy, because "Houston Texans" now has two top prizes left of the four it launched with. When the top of the board changes, the whole game changes with it. All of it comes straight from official Texas lottery numbers, current through September 15.
2755.headline: One less $100,000 out there

2769.headline: A progress report

2770.body: The big board on "Lucky 7 Tripler" just moved: one $1 million top prize was claimed in the latest numbers, leaving three of the original four still out there. Everything below the top tier is still in play — this page has the full count. The numbers get re-crunched every morning, and this page moves with them.
2770.headline: Scratch one big winner off the list

2771.body: Only a small slice of the tickets are already gone, which makes this game fresh into its run. Why care? Because the same prizes mean different things early versus late — the stack they're hiding in keeps shrinking. Right now: four of four top prizes left, and neither side of that race is winning right now. If you're a regular on this game, bookmark it — this write-up refreshes with every morning's data.
2771.headline: A progress report
